details.fullName: Lao National Unexploded Ordnance Programme (UXO Lao)

details.leadership: Mr. Anousak Phongsa, National Programme Director (NPD)
details.workforce: 1,552 total personnel in 2024 (436 women, ~28%), operating 124 field teams across 9 heavily contaminated provinces (9 EORE, 9 NTS, 15 TS, 81 Area Clearance, 2 Roving, 4 Brush Cutting, 4 Vegetation Cutting teams).
mandateAndRole: Established in 1996 with UNDP and UNICEF support as Lao PDR’s flagship national humanitarian clearance operator.
Mandated to reduce UXO casualties and release high-priority agricultural and development land.

Under the UNDP NIM Project (funded by NZ and Luxembourg), UXO Lao executes Output 1 (Survey & Clearance) and Output 2 (EORE) in Xiengkhouang, Khammouane, Champasak, and Xekong, and operates the renovated UXO Lao Visitor Center in Luang Prabang.

details.fullName: National Regulatory Authority for the UXO/Mine Action Sector in Lao PDR (NRA)
details.supervisingMinistry: Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MoFA, transferred from MoLSW in Sept 2023; restructured under PM Decree No. 166/GOV in March 2025)

details.workforce: 51 core staff at NRA Secretariat (following 2025 fit-for-purpose institutional review, streamlined from 74) + 13 Provincial Regulatory Authorities (PRAs) + oversight of 22 teams (212 personnel) of Army Unit 58 / Center 523.
mandateAndRole: Serves as the national regulatory body and secretariat to the inter-ministerial NRA Board.

Sets national strategy (Safe Path Forward III 2021–2030), maintains National Mine Action Standards (NMAS), accredits and conducts external QA/QC on all humanitarian and commercial operators, manages the national IMSMA Core database, coordinates Victim Assistance and EORE radio broadcasting, and leads international treaty compliance (CCM, CCW, APMBC).
Acts as Implementing Partner for the NRA NIM Project (00120365) and Responsible Party for the Australia DIM PIP (01006631).
